text:
The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm, though the photo is taken at an angle. The main item is a meatloaf slab roughly 12 cm long, 7 cm wide and 4 cm thick. That is about 300 cm³, but the shape is probably smaller than a full box, so I estimate about 200 cm³, or roughly 200 g. The meatloaf has a glaze, so I put it at about 1.5 kcal/g, which gives about 300 kcal.

The small roll weighs about 40 g and adds about 110 kcal.

Total: about 240 g of food and about 410 kcal.
